title: Nodes persist under extension of algebraically closed fields
statement: Let $k\subseteq\Omega$ be algebraically closed fields [def-weil-algebraic-closure], with $\Omega$ a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension], and let $C$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume that every point of $C$ at which $C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is not smooth (has no open neighbourhood smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]) has maximal-ideal-adic completed local ring [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] isomorphic as a ring to $k[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Put $C_\Omega=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then every point of $C_\Omega$ at which $C_\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is not smooth has completed local ring isomorphic as a ring to $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$. The scheme $C$ may be empty; no quasi-compactness, separatedness or dimension hypothesis is imposed.
